items.item_text: Basic Life Support - CPR - authorized by the American Heart Association

Technical Skills: Is competent in psychomotor skills and technical procedures. Pre-operative procedures include the following. Practices aseptic technique in preparing for and assisting with surgical procedures and ensures sterile field integrity is maintained. Performs hand scrub according to unit structure standards. Intra-operative procedures include the following. Sets up and maintains back table in sterile organized manner. Obtains/maintains adequate supplies for surgeon, anticipates needs and is active participant in surgical procedure. Performs count of sponges, needles, and instruments at the direction of the circulating RN. Other duties as directed by surgeon or circulating RN with the scope of their practice. Post-operative procedures include the following. Isolates sharps to facilitate safe handling by assistants. Assists with disposal of all used supplies, sharps, linen and waste, using Body Substance Isolation procedure. Takes used equipment to cleaning area. Helps ready the room for the next case. Demonstrates ability to assist all team members in the performance of procedures. Performs job duties of unit assistant as directed to meet needs of patient/unit. Demonstrates proficiency on Health Information Systems, supply orders, departmental data/reports relating to job duties.
Documentation: Performs legible, timely, concise and accurate documentation according to policies and procedures. Proficient and competent with the computerized documentation system.
Organizational Skills: Uses appropriate organization, priority setting and problem solving skills.
Communication: Communicates clearly and effectively using proper communication etiquette. Uses medical terminology accurately.

Self Development: Is accountable for self-directed learning and participation in continuing education to meet own professional development. Participates in relevant inservice programs and continuing education activities.
Patient Safety: Applies safety precautions and principles to patient care. Includes all National Patient Safety Goals.
